scope: One-folder backend layout and its integration into an installed, unsigned macOS arm64 Nexus Studio.app. Builds on the portable builder and SDK profile gate in STUDIO-DESKTOP-BUNDLE-CHECKPOINT.json / STUDIO-DESKTOP-PROFILES-CHECKPOINT.json (other agent). Core profile only; not signed, not Linux/Windows.

layout_measurements.method: Same PyInstaller 6.22.3 inputs; executable launched as the shell does (own process group, credential on stdin); stop line, EOF and group SIGKILL each measured once.

implemented: build_bundle builds --onedir into nexus-backend-<target>/ (executable nexus-sidecar + _internal/), staged with rollback to the previous folder; never replaces the tracked nexus-sidecar-<target> development wrapper file. Manifest nexus-desktop-bundle/v2 adds layout, file count, size and tree_sha256 (content hash; file links by content, directory aliases skipped) so an installed copy verifies. The other agent's profile self-checks are unchanged.

build_desktop.py writes tauri.bundle.conf.json next to the bundle: bundle.resources maps the folder to sidecar/ and bundle.externalBin is emptied, so releases never ship the development wrapper. npm run build passes it to tauri build --config.
The shell spawns resource_dir/sidecar/nexus-sidecar when present; only debug builds fall back to the externalBin development wrapper; a release without the bundle shows the local spawn error.
Build outputs under src-tauri/binaries are git-ignored; the relocated example copies the whole folder.

installed_drills.install: ditto into <scratchpad>/Install Root/Applications/Nexus Studio.app (path with spaces, outside the repo)
installed_drills.environment: env -i HOME USER TMPDIR PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, cwd /
observed: Backend process is the bundled executable inside the installed app; one process leading its own group; listening 0.84–1.49 s after launch.
No open files under the source checkout for shell or backend; workspace lock held by the backend.
Backend alive 20 s later (any readiness, session or navigation failure stops it); ~70 client connections from the webview; anonymous /api/bootstrap 401.
User confirmed the full Studio UI and closed the window: shell and backend exited, lock free, no processes, no extraction folders.
SIGKILL and SIGTERM to the shell (final build): backend exited, lock free, no processes.
installed_drills.cleanup: Drill-created Application Support, WebKit and Caches folders for com.nexusarc.studio removed after each run.

known_limits: Tauri's resource copy drops Python.framework directory aliases and dereferences its file links (~10 MB duplicated). Runtime unaffected; signing/notarization need a proper framework layout and a Developer ID (none available).
Core profile only; SDK-complete installed build not yet made.
No DMG, Linux AppImage/deb or Windows installer built; Windows/Linux resource paths and cleanup untested.
The window-close drill ran on the build before the bundle-folder rename and hash change; the final build was drilled with SIGKILL/SIGTERM only.
correction: STUDIO-DESKTOP-INSTALLED-CHECKPOINT.json said the flattened framework layout would not pass code signing; ad-hoc deep verification passes for it. The verified blocker for notarization is that --deep does not sign Mach-O files under Contents/Resources.
